ideas.title: Federal Surveillance Operation in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the federal surveillance operation in Minnesota and its impact on progressive groups and unions
questions: What was the extent of the surveillance operation?
How did it impact progressive groups and unions?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose government overreach and abuse of power. By investigating the surveillance operation and its impact, we can shed light on the importance of civil liberties and the need for accountability.
